description: Pittston, PA – President Donald J. Trump has endorsed Congressman Rob Bresnahan for re-election in Pennsylvania’s 8th Congressional District, praising him as a strong conservative leader and successful businessman who is fighting to create jobs, cut taxes, stop wasteful spending, secure the border, and protect the Second Amendment.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Rob for PA
title: President Donald J. Trump Endorses Congressman Rob Bresnahan - Rob for PA
